method: centered-dipole geomagnetic coordinates from the degree-1 IGRF-13 coefficients (g10, g11, h11) at epoch 2022.5, linearly extrapolated from the 2020.0 values with the IGRF-13 2020-2025 secular variation; north geomagnetic pole: colatitude theta0 = acos(-g10/B0), east longitude lambda0 = atan2(-h11, -g11), B0 = sqrt(g10^2+g11^2+h11^2); MAG frame per Hapgood (1992): Z along the dipole axis (north), Y = Z x (geographic south pole) direction, X completes, so the geographic north pole lies at geomagnetic longitude 180; geomagnetic latitude = asin(Z component), longitude = atan2(Y, X) in [0, 360). Boulder control (40.0N, 254.7E) -> (47.7, 322.2), the textbook value. NOT quasi-dipole, NOT AACGM, NOT corrected geomagnetic: those need a full-field tracing library the governed environment does not pin.
epoch_sensitivity_note: moving the epoch from 2022.5 to 2022.0 changes every station value by less than 0.02 degrees (secular variation of the dipole terms is 5.7/7.4/-25.9 nT per year)
